purpose: Bounded self-owned inventory of every accepted materialized Routine/Event Occurrence belonging to the selected Occurrence source, including skipped and scheduled instances; incomplete inventories are rejected.

routine.return_type: TABLE(occurrence_ref uuid, source_native_ref uuid, governing_recurrence_state_ref uuid, origin_code text, family_code text, generated_date date, generated_wall_time time, clock_basis_code text, zone_id text, resolved_at timestamptz, expected_at timestamptz, period_start_date date, period_end_date_exclusive date, frame_code text, quota_zone_id text, position_index integer, skipped boolean, skip_reason text, skipped_at timestamptz)

state_history.current_binding: Read-only: derives all canonical materialized source Occurrences through existing self-scoped get_self_occurrence; never implies as-yet-unmaterialized future candidates are present.
state_history.chronology: The read retains immutable governing Recurrence coordinates and skip history regardless of Schedule placement. No browser-window filtering or mutation.
state_history.immutability_policy: Source ownership from selected self Occurrence; 10000 rows maximum, 10001 fails closed. Apply still requires source/instance CAS and exception handling.

lifecycle.retention: Bounded derived read only; no new stored facts.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime delete or write capability.

obligations: Selected Occurrence self scope (Routine and Event)
Return all accepted materialized source Occurrences, regardless of skip/current Schedule
No direct dante_runtime table SELECT or INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE
Return never claims unmaterialized future inventory
